water_bills_amounts_chk.name: water_bills_amounts_chk
water_bills_amounts_chk.value: "water_bills"."basic_charge" >= 0 AND "water_bills"."senior_discount" >= 0 AND "water_bills"."other_charges" >= 0 AND "water_bills"."advance_applied" >= 0 AND "water_bills"."previous_balance" >= 0 AND "water_bills"."current_amount" = "water_bills"."basic_charge" - "water_bills"."senior_discount" + "water_bills"."other_charges" AND "water_bills"."advance_applied" <= "water_bills"."current_amount" AND "water_bills"."total_amount_due" = "water_bills"."current_amount" - "water_bills"."advance_applied" + "water_bills"."previous_balance"

water_customers_name_chk.name: water_customers_name_chk
water_customers_name_chk.value: ("water_customers"."last_name" IS NOT NULL AND "water_customers"."first_name" IS NOT NULL) OR "water_customers"."business_name" IS NOT NULL

share_withdrawals_paid_chk.name: share_withdrawals_paid_chk
share_withdrawals_paid_chk.value: ("share_withdrawals"."status" = 'PAID') = ("share_withdrawals"."je_id" IS NOT NULL AND "share_withdrawals"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL)

deposit_transactions_sign_chk.name: deposit_transactions_sign_chk
deposit_transactions_sign_chk.value: "deposit_transactions"."amount" <> 0 AND ("deposit_transactions"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' OR ("deposit_transactions"."type" IN ('DEPOSIT', 'INTEREST', 'TRANSFER_IN') AND "deposit_transactions"."amount" > 0) OR ("deposit_transactions"."type" IN ('WITHDRAWAL', 'WTAX', 'TRANSFER_OUT') AND "deposit_transactions"."amount" < 0))

loan_products_amounts_chk.name: loan_products_amounts_chk
loan_products_amounts_chk.value: "loan_products"."min_amount" >= 0 AND ("loan_products"."max_amount" IS NULL OR "loan_products"."max_amount" >= "loan_products"."min_amount") AND "loan_products"."required_comakers" >= 0 AND "loan_products"."grace_days" >= 0

loan_schedule_amounts_chk.name: loan_schedule_amounts_chk
loan_schedule_amounts_chk.value: "loan_schedule"."principal_due" >= 0 AND "loan_schedule"."interest_due" >= 0 AND "loan_schedule"."principal_paid" BETWEEN 0 AND "loan_schedule"."principal_due" AND "loan_schedule"."interest_paid" BETWEEN 0 AND "loan_schedule"."interest_due" AND "loan_schedule"."penalty_paid" BETWEEN 0 AND "loan_schedule"."penalty_accrued"

sale_returns_amounts_chk.name: sale_returns_amounts_chk
sale_returns_amounts_chk.value: "sale_returns"."total" > 0 AND "sale_returns"."cost" >= 0 AND "sale_returns"."cash_refund" >= 0 AND "sale_returns"."ar_credit" >= 0 AND "sale_returns"."cash_refund" + "sale_returns"."ar_credit" = "sale_returns"."total" AND ("sale_returns"."cash_refund" = 0 OR "sale_returns"."shift_id" IS NOT NULL) AND (("sale_returns"."refund_mode" = 'CASH') = ("sale_returns"."ar_credit" = 0))

sales_member_chk.name: sales_member_chk
sales_member_chk.value: ("sales"."customer_type" = 'MEMBER') = ("sales"."member_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sales"."payment" = 'CASH' OR "sales"."member_id" IS NOT NULL)

sales_amounts_chk.name: sales_amounts_chk
sales_amounts_chk.value: "sales"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "sales"."discount" >= 0 AND "sales"."total" = "sales"."subtotal" - "sales"."discount" AND ("sales"."change" IS NULL OR ("sales"."change" >= 0 AND "sales"."tendered" = "sales"."total" + "sales"."change"))

sales_posted_chk.name: sales_posted_chk
sales_posted_chk.value: ("sales"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("sales"."je_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sales"."status" = 'COMPLETED' OR ("sales"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."voided_by" <> "sales"."cashier_id"))

stock_count_lines_qty_chk.name: stock_count_lines_qty_chk
stock_count_lines_qty_chk.value: ("stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" IS NULL OR "stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" >= 0) AND ("stock_count_lines"."system_qty" IS NULL OR "stock_count_lines"."system_qty" >= 0) AND ("stock_count_lines"."variance" IS NULL OR "stock_count_lines"."variance" = "stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" - "stock_count_lines"."system_qty")

stock_counts_sod_chk.name: stock_counts_sod_chk
stock_counts_sod_chk.value: "stock_counts"."approved_by" IS NULL OR ("stock_counts"."approved_by" <> "stock_counts"."prepared_by" AND "stock_counts"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "stock_counts"."submitted_by")

stock_moves_amounts_chk.name: stock_moves_amounts_chk
stock_moves_amounts_chk.value: "stock_moves"."qty" <> 0 AND (("stock_moves"."qty" > 0 AND "stock_moves"."total_cost" >= 0) OR ("stock_moves"."qty" < 0 AND "stock_moves"."total_cost" <= 0)) AND "stock_moves"."qty_after" >= 0 AND "stock_moves"."value_after" >= 0
